scripts.dev: npm run build -w @velozity/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @velozity/server" "npm run dev -w @velozity/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @velozity/shared && npm run build -w @velozity/server && npm run build -w @velozity/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @velozity/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @velozity/shared && npm run test -w @velozity/server
